name: Coming to Terms
summary: A frightened former paladin has fled into the hills west of the chapel. Aramis Hammerhand asks a newly risen knight to reach her with compassion.

sections.title: A Bitter Resurrection
sections.body: The Silver Hand's former paladins wake among the Forsaken in shock. In life, they served the Holy Light and fought the undead. Now their souls are bound to decomposing flesh. Aramis Hammerhand guides some through this change, while others flee into the Tirisfal wilderness, unable to face their new existence.

sections.title: A Merciful Release
sections.body: A panicked paladin hides in the hills west of the chapel. Aramis Hammerhand hopes a fellow knight can reach her with compassion. The weight of her transformation overwhelms her. When approached, she strikes in fear and fury, leaving no choice but to strike her down. For a Forsaken whose mind shatters upon the grave, a swift end is the only mercy left.

aliases: who is the paladin in the hills
who do i find in coming to terms
faq.answer: She is a recently risen Forsaken who served as a paladin in life. Horrified to wake undead, she fled Deathknell into the nearby western hills.

faq.q: Why does the frightened paladin attack?
aliases: can you save the frightened paladin
faq.answer: She fears becoming the kind of creature she once fought and cannot accept her new existence. Aramis warns that some newly risen paladins become violent and asks you to approach her with compassion.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Coming to Terms?
aliases: where to start coming to terms
faq.answer: Aramis Hammerhand, a paladin mentor at the church in Deathknell, offers this guidance to newly risen knights so they can understand the fragile state of their peers.

faq.q: Can Forsaken still wield the Light?
aliases: do forsaken paladins use the light
faq.answer: Yes. Risen paladins like Aramis Hammerhand still serve the Light, and he hopes to guide newly risen paladins back to it.

faq.q: Where is the frightened paladin located?
faq.answer: She fled west from the church in Deathknell and hid among the wooded hills overlooking the settlement.

faq.q: What happens after completing Coming to Terms?
faq.answer: You return to Aramis Hammerhand to report on your attempt to help the frightened paladin. He then sends you to further training to hone your discipline as a Forsaken paladin.

angles.text: As a paladin, you face the horror of undeath and the struggle to accept what you have become.
As an Undead, you see how the shock of awakening in Tirisfal can overwhelm the newly risen. Helping those in panic is part of early Forsaken life.
